tác_động: Large date range query may take seconds. No spinner → người dùng taps again → potential duplicate requests.

references.name: Doherty Threshold
references.quote: Productivity soars when a computer and its users interact at a pace that ensures neither has to wait on the other.

hiện_trạng: Validation error shown via popup 'Thông báo' only — no inline field-level errors. người dùng phải dismiss popup, remember which field was wrong.
tác_động: Popup validation = bad UX. người dùng dismisses popup → forgets which field → tries giống nhau thing. Inline error next to field = immediate fix.
nguyên_tắc: Nielsen #9: Inline errors at field level. WCAG 3.3.1: Error identified at item.
đề_xuất_steps: Inline error text below each invalid field
Red border on error field
Scroll to first error with focus

hiện_trạng: Typo: 'Trang thái tra soát' — đúng: 'Trạng thái tra soát'. Thiếu chữ 'g'. Visible trên 2 artboards.
tác_động: Repeated typo across screens → systematic QA gap. Financial app typo = trust erosion.
nguyên_tắc: Nielsen #4: Text correctness across all instances. Systemic typo = no spell-check in design process.

tác_động: DDL empty-state-1 requires icon + title + description + optional CTA. Current = minimal text.

đề_xuất_steps: Vị trí

tác_động: Color-only badges = inaccessible for color-blind người dùng (~8% male population). WCAG 1.4.1 violation.
nguyên_tắc: WCAG 1.4.1: Color not the only visual means. thêm icons or text patterns per status.

hiện_trạng: Link 'Chi tiết giao dịch ›' — text color normal, no underline, chevron nhỏ, touch target small. Không trông interactive.

nguyên_tắc: Nielsen #6: Links must look like links. Underline or distinct color + adequate touch target.
